cohort: 314 term neonates under 14 days of age presenting with unexplained indirect hyperbilirubinemia
finding: The prevalence of UTI in asymptomatic term neonates diagnosed with indirect hyperbilirubinemia within the first two weeks of birth was 3.8%, with E. coli being the most prevalent pathogen.
mod_finding: No significant differences were observed between neonates with and without UTI in terms of mode of delivery.
